title: CosmologyMeta
description: Optional meta-universe layer above franchise. A cosmology groups multiple universes under a shared creation myth / magic theorem / physics (Sanderson-style). Member universes reference this file via universe_meta.cosmology_id. Consumed lazily: presence of this file does not change any engine behaviour by itself; it provides a registry for cross-universe shared lore and rules.

cosmology_id.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must match the directory name under data/cosmologies/.

description.description: Summary of the cosmology's premise and what the member universes share.

shared_lore.description: Cosmology-wide lore entries that every member universe inherits (e.g., 'Investiture', 'The Shattering'). String references; actual lore records live in the worldbuilding store under a parentless universe whose id equals cosmology_id.

shared_rules.description: Rules that apply across member universes (e.g., 'magic stems from Investiture', 'Shards cannot fully die'). Advisory; engine enforcement is deferred.

member_universes.description: Universe ids that belong to this cosmology. Each member universe's universe_meta.cosmology_id should point back here.
